speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have some skin concerns; please describe the specific lesions you are worried about, including their size, shape, color, and how they have changed over time. Also, when did you first notice them?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC) of the penis and digit.

The patient's history of heavy smoking, age, and unsuccessful treatment for syphilis raises high suspicion for malignancy given the non-healing, crusty nature of lesions on the penis and finger.

I am requesting a biopsy of the penile lesion immediately to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Penile_lesion_Biopsy, Left_finger_lesion_Biopsy.
